data_points.source_name: Tracxn legal-entity financial profile (sourced from India MCA/ROC filings) -- Vini Cosmetics Pvt Ltd, maker of Fogg deodorants
data_points.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: company-level (Vini Cosmetics Pvt Ltd, maker of Fogg -- Indias largest deodorant brand by volume share, ~15-16%), not a category-wide India deodorants market figure; used as proxy since Vini Cosmetics is a deodorant-focused company, unlike HUL/Godrej/ITC where deo is one line among many and no brand-level figure could be found in any fetchable source despite repeated attempts. Direct quote from source: VINI COSMETICS PRIVATE LIMITED generated more than INR 1,000 Cr in revenue for the financial year ending on Mar 31, 2025. The revenue has a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17% in the last 1 year. Tracxns 1-year CAGR is mathematically a single-year YoY growth rate (CAGR over exactly one year reduces to simple YoY), so this is not a CAGR-to-YoY substitution. Underlying data sourced by Tracxn from India MCA/ROC company filings; exact FY24 comparator and units not shown in free view. Corroborating datapoint, not a separate claim: McNroe Consumer Products (Wild Stone, #2 deodorant maker) shows a similar 1-year CAGR of 20% for FY25 on the same Tracxn platform -- consistent directionally, do not average. Organised-market only; no unorganised-market read implied.
